title: QSim-Arena: an evolving developer for quantum simulation advantage
abstract: arXiv:2611.15000v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Where practical advantage emerges in quantum dynamics simulation remains a central debate in quantum computing. Claimed advantages can be rapidly narrowed or overturned by stronger classical methods, while progress on both sides can outpace the journal publication cycle. We present QSim-Arena, a research framework in which AI agents combine a closed loop of verification and benchmarking with open exploration. Hamiltonians, initial states and accuracy targets for evolved states or observable expectation values provide explicit specifications for evaluating simulation methods. Agents translate published techniques into executable components, reproduce reported results and benchmark their performance across diverse Hamiltonian families. Competing classical methods are implemented and independently crosschecked, providing credible baselines for end-to-end quantum resource estimates based on rigorous error bounds and empirical calibration.

translated_title: QSim-Arena：面向量子模拟优势的进化型开发者
translated_abstract: 量子动力学模拟中实际优势在何处产生，仍是量子计算领域的核心争论。所声称的优势可能很快被更强的经典方法缩小或推翻，而双方的进展速度可能超过期刊出版周期。我们提出 QSim-Arena，一个让 AI 智能体将验证与基准测试闭环和开放式探索相结合的研究框架。哈密顿量、初始态以及演化态或可观测量期望值的精度目标，为评估模拟方法提供了明确的规范。智能体将已发表的技术转化为可执行组件，复现已报告的结果，并在多种哈密顿量族上对其性能进行基准测试。相互竞争的经典方法被实现并经过独立交叉检验，为基于严格误差界限和经验校准的端到端量子资源估计提供了可信的基线。
tldr: 该论文提出 QSim-Arena 框架，让 AI 智能体在验证与基准测试的闭环中开发、复现并比较量子与经典模拟方法，从而动态追踪和评估量子模拟的实际优势。
en_tdlr: This paper presents QSim-Arena, a research framework in which AI agents develop, reproduce, and benchmark quantum and classical simulation methods within a closed loop of verification and benchmarking to dynamically track and assess practical quantum simulation advantage.
